pure interface of class zeta.agl.Seq<A>

The documentated page. 
public abstract class Seq<A>
  extends Aggregate<A>
{
    public A head()
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public A last()
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public Seq<A> tail()
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public A at(int index)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public Seq<A> update(int index,
                         A elem);
    public Seq<A> append(A elem);
    public Seq<A> appendAll(Aggregate<A> other);
    public Seq<A> prepend(A elem);
    public Seq<A> prependAll(Aggregate<A> other);
    public Seq<A> insert(int at,
                         A elem)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public abstract Seq<A> insertAll(int at,
                                     Aggregate<A> other)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public int indexOf(A elem);
    public int indexOf((A) -> boolean p);
    public int lastIndexOf(A elem);
    public int lastIndexOf((A) -> boolean p);
    public Seq<A> subseq(int at)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public Seq<A> subseq(int at,
                         int end);
    public Seq<A> subseq(int at,
                         (A) -> boolean p)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public abstract Seq<A> subseq(int at,
                                  int end,
                                  (A) -> boolean p)
      throws IndexOutOfBoundsException;
    public abstract Seq<A> sort((A, A) -> int ecompare);
    public abstract Seq<A> revert();
    public abstract <B> Seq<B> map((A) -> B f);
    public abstract Seq<A> filter((A) -> boolean p);
    public Pair<Seq<A>, Seq<A>> partition((A) -> boolean p);
    public static <B> Seq<B> flatten(Seq<B> empty,
                                     Seq<Seq<B>> s);
    public boolean equals(Object other);
    public int hashCode();
    public Seq();
}
